newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TRADE UP, INDEX RISES 10 PCT ON BOURSE IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: TRADE UP, INDEX RISES 10 PCT ON BOURSE IN JUNE.

text.p: The Tallinn stock exchange said on Tuesday that its turnover rose by 196 million kroons in June and the Talse index was up by 9.85 percent to 276.24.
The total turnover was 1.1 billion kroons and the trade in the main and secondary list shares accounted for 87.6 percent of overall market volume, the bourse said in a statement.
Trade in Hansapank accounted for 23.3 percent of the total turnover and trade in Hoiupank for 19.8 percent.
Hansapank also gained the most or 13.95 percent to 147.00 kroons. Hoiupank gained 13.6 percent during the month to 150.25 kroons.
The biggest loser on the official list was Pennu, which shed 6.46 percent to 73.90 kroons.
On the free market, the privatisation vouchers rose the most or 14.84 percent to 0.33 kroons. they were also the most active in trade of 39 million kroons.
Estiko fell the most on the free market to 35 kroons, a fall of 12.5 percent during the month.
